entities.name: Ryōkichi Inada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ryukichi Inada  was a Japanese physician, prominent academic, and bacteriologist researcher. He discovered the Weil's disease pathogen. In addition to his life's work in early 20th-century Japanese medical education, he was a pioneer in Japanese clinical cardiology and oncology.
